title: Dataset/reporting rebind state analogue
purpose: Cover the reporting-related lifetime interaction by using a small stateful sequence: first establish a lightweight association-like setup, then send a report-style payload with repeated dataset/report identifiers that can be mutated toward stale-binding and re-enable scenarios.
expected_behavior: A target that supports reporting should either reject the simplified sequence or process it without dereferencing stale dataset state; a harness may still gain valuable coverage over report/dataset handling and state transitions.
constraints_preserved: tpkt version byte is 0x03 in all messages
tpkt total lengths match complete messages
state diversity increased with multi-message sequence
reporting path included per family constraints
issue_safety_notes: This is a conservative stateful analogue for report/dataset lifetime interaction, not a reproduction of any PoC and not an externally verified protocol transcript.
